Bash(FILTER_BRANCH_SQUELCH_WARNING=1 git filter-branch -f --msg-filter 'python -c ""
import sys
content = sys.stdin.read()
lines = content.split(\""\\n\"")
filtered_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if \""Co-Authored-By: Claude\"" not in line and \""🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\"" not in line:
        filtered_lines.append(line)
# Remove trailing empty lines
while filtered_lines and not filtered_lines[-1].strip():
    filtered_lines.pop()
print(\""\\n\"".join(filtered_lines))
""' --env-filter 'export GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=""$GIT_AUTHOR_DATE""' HEAD~5..HEAD)
